Subject: On-call moves to 3-day shifts starting June 2

Hi team,

Starting June 2, the on-call rotation moves from weekly shifts to shifts that run every 3 days. The shorter shifts should mean fresher coverage and a more even workload across the week.

The on-call pool now has 9 engineers. Each shift also pays a $150 bonus.

Handoff notes are required at every changeover.

If you have questions, ask your team lead or post in #on-call.

The Engineering Leadership Team
